rules.reason: Schedule boundary marker, already confirmed as 8 L1 boundaries across all sheets
Page-break continuation markers — must fire BEFORE chapter-label regex (R02) to prevent CONT'D variants like 《4.4 - PARTITION WORKS (CONT'D)》 from being misclassified as L2
Aggregate/summary rows — L4 data-level, not heading or note
Chapter labels (X.X - Description) — CONT'D variants already caught by R01b above
Schedule 1 Preliminaries section headings identified by X.X numeric code (1.0-19.0), including their (Cont'd) page-break continuations
Rows with unit AND quantity are L4 bill items — forced, no exceptions
NRM L3 preamble section preceding trade-level items; appears after every L2 chapter label in work-package schedules (2-7), 19 occurrences

ALL-CAPS rows not matching building keywords are trade-level sub-groupings within work packages (Q1: not independent asset). Includes trade names (FORMWORK, REINFORCEMENT, EXCAVATION), generic groups (OTHER, MISCELLANEOUS), and area categories (EXTERNAL ROADS, CARRIAGEWAYS). 83 rows

Contract clause citation references (e.g. 2.01 Employer, 3.05 Works carried out under separate contracts). Not structural headings, purely contractual reference text. 117 rows, predominantly in Schedule 1
Numbered explanatory notes (e.g. 1. The Tenderer shall...) within preamble sections. 101 rows
Contractual obligation language indicating descriptive/instructional text rather than structural heading
Preamble boilerplate intro text (In addition to the preamble notes, the following apply...)
Provisional sum / allowance directive, not a structural heading
Provisional sum / allowance directive variant
Specification compliance directive, descriptive text
Work instruction / specification directive text
Specification enumeration preamble, descriptive text
Full-sentence descriptive text ending with period; work descriptions (e.g. concrete filling to bored pile shafts, fabrication and fixing of reinforcement) are not structural headings
Concrete strength specification text (f’c(MPa)32 reinforced concrete filling etc.); these are material spec descriptions, not structural headings
Specification reference language indicating descriptive compliance text, not a structural heading
Drawing/specification reference language in descriptive work items

Catch-all: remaining non-empty text assumed to be work sub-group headings (L3). Includes Title Case element names (Doors and Door Frames, Precast Columns), specification-type finish names (Waterborne Epoxy Floor Coating - F3, 300 mm High Anti-Static Raised Access Floor - F7), material grade labels (Reinforced Concrete Grades), and partition/element type labels (AAC Wall Panels, Glazed Partitions). ~85 rows across all work-package schedules. Step 4 boundary agent may override specific cases.
